title: Influence comparison by threshold weights
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be represented as $f(x)=\operatorname{sgn}(a_0+\sum_{k=1}^n a_kx_k)$, with the threshold sign equal to $1$ when its argument is nonnegative and $-1$ otherwise. For any coordinates $i,j$, if $|a_i|\leq |a_j|$, then $\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)\leq\operatorname{Inf}_j(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: There are real coefficients $a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n$ representing $f$ by the stated threshold rule
